name: sap-cpi-iflow-builder
description: Guides SAP Cloud Integration iFlow design and template-based ZIP preparation. Local generator source included; a hosted MCP service is needed for in-chat ZIP generation.

interface.longDescription: Design SAP Cloud Integration integration flows, review SAP-exported template requirements, and guide use of the included local ZIP generator. In-chat artifact generation is not connected until the MCP backend is deployed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me design an SAP Cloud Integration iFlow and prepare the inputs for a downloadable design-time ZIP.
